description: Publication color-palette definitions for TreeSHAP Figure 3 (class-feature importance heatmap) and Figure 4 (instance-level SHAP panels).

reference_A_aggregated_heatmap.figure_role: Figure 3: 6 classes x 13 features 2D TreeSHAP heatmap palette and layout specification.
reference_A_aggregated_heatmap.colorbar: right side, High at top, Low at bottom; represents mean absolute TreeSHAP magnitude

reference_B_sample_panels.figure_role: Figure 4: Six-class instance-level TreeSHAP 2x3 panel layout and color scale specification.
reference_B_sample_panels.colorbar: right side, High at top, Low at bottom; scaled to underlying signed/normalized SHAP plot values

notes: Color-palette configuration only; all numerical values are computed directly from the archived SHAP summaries and per_sample_shap_6417.npz.
